Used to display specific legacy protocol for FiveCo's network cards.

What the idea of this ?

This protocol is a question/answer system. `g_unInternalID` is used to match answer with questions.
`FCOSRegisterDef` is used to define standard registers accessible through this protocol. Standard registers are registers available on every devices on which this protocol is implemented.
A table of the standard register is build to :
- fill hf table with BASE_CUSTOM elements for known registers in proto_register_FiveCoLegacy().
- detect known register index in questions and answers to display corresponding data in dissector tree (by direct interpretation or through functions registered in BASE_CUSTOM hf elements) in dissect_FiveCoLegacy(...).
do you have pcap to share ?
Yes. Here it is: [5co-legacy.pcapng](/uploads/413730e979db5714d4827c6666635d4b/5co-legacy.pcapng)
